Control settings for Armijo backtracking line search

Source: R/armijo.R
ArmijoControl.Rd

Tuning parameters for an objective-only Armijo line search. This line search is currently intended for optimizer = "bfgs" fits where trial objective evaluations are cheaper than repeated full objective-plus-gradient evaluations during Hager-Zhang line search.

Usage

ArmijoControl(
  initial = 1,
  contraction = 0.5,
  sufficient_decrease = 1e-04,
  maxit = 25L,
  min_alpha = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

initial

Initial trial step length.

contraction

Multiplicative shrinkage applied after rejected trial steps. Must be strictly between 0 and 1.

sufficient_decrease

Armijo sufficient-decrease constant.

maxit

Maximum number of backtracking steps.

min_alpha

Smallest step length to try before stopping.

verbose

Should line-search progress be printed?

Value

A list of class "terradish_armijo_control" holding the validated Armijo line-search settings (type, initial, contraction, sufficient_decrease, maxit, min_alpha, and verbose), suitable for the ls.control element of a NewtonRaphsonControl object.

Details

ArmijoControl() is opt-in. The default optimizer control continues to use HagerZhangControl. Armijo trial steps only evaluate the objective, so rejected steps avoid the gradient/backpropagation work required by Hager-Zhang. After a step is accepted, BFGS still evaluates the full gradient once at the accepted point so the quasi-Newton update remains well-defined.

See also

NewtonRaphsonControl, HagerZhangControl

Other optimizer controls: HagerZhangControl(), NewtonRaphsonControl()

Examples

ctrl <- NewtonRaphsonControl(
  maxit = 25,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ls.control = ArmijoControl()
)
str(ctrl$ls.control)
#> List of 7
#>  $ type               : chr "armijo"
#>  $ initial            : num 1
#>  $ contraction        : num 0.5
#>  $ sufficient_decrease: num 1e-04
#>  $ maxit              : int 25
#>  $ min_alpha          : num 1.49e-08
#>  $ verbose            : logi FALSE
#>  - attr(*, "class")= chr [1:2] "terradish_armijo_control" "list"
